title: ChatGPT for small business, Claude Opus 5, and cheaper Gemini models
excerpt: OpenAI launched a ChatGPT for small business program, Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 at half the price of Fable 5, and Google pushed cheaper, faster Gemini models.

items.h: OpenAI launches a ChatGPT for small business program
items.t: OpenAI introduced a program to help small businesses be more productive and scale with ChatGPT. It includes hands-on virtual training, in-person small business AI academies (in the US), new guides and new agents and partners built for small business. The announcement did not state a price. Check which parts are open to you outside the US.

items.h: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5, cheaper than Fable 5
items.t: CNBC reported that Anthropic says Opus 5 is its best-performing and most cost-effective model. It outperforms Fable 5 on coding and knowledge-work evaluations at half the price ($5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens). It is not state of the art for risky capabilities such as cybersecurity or biology, where Mythos 5 leads. CNBC says businesses are cost-conscious and want proof of return before using pricey models.

items.h: Google releases cheaper Gemini models, but Gemini 3.5 Pro is not ready
items.t: Axios reported that Google released a series of cheaper Gemini models. Business Insider reported that Google says it is doubling down on cheaper, faster AI while Gemini 3.5 Pro still is not ready. Reuters, citing The Information, reported that Google plans a new chip to run Gemini more efficiently.
OpenAI announced Health in ChatGPT. AI can help you prepare for and understand a doctor's visit, but it is not a doctor. Do not change medication or treatment because of a chatbot.

water.h: A $1.5 billion settlement, and unhappy engineers
water.t: The Associated Press reported that a judge approved a $1.5 billion settlement by Anthropic over pirated books used to train Claude. Axios reported that Google's Gemini delay exposes deeper employee frustration at DeepMind.

means.t: Watch OpenAI's small business guides, which are often useful even if you cannot attend US events. Look for the practical agents and templates.
Model prices are falling and quality is rising. When someone says "AI is too expensive", ask which model and which task. The answer changes every few months.
For health, legal or money questions, use AI to prepare questions and understand terms, then speak to a professional.

prompt: I run [business] in [city] and spend about [hours] a week on [admin task]. Using the free or cheapest AI option, design a simple weekly routine that cuts that time in half. List the exact steps, the prompt for each step, and the one check I must do myself. Keep it under 6 steps.

reads.h: Google doubles down on cheaper, faster AI, but says Gemini 3.5 Pro still isn't ready
Google plans new chip to run Gemini models more efficiently
Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
